chunks: And He has revealed to you in the Book that when you hear the verses of Allah being denied or ridiculed, do not sit with them until they engage in other discourse; indeed, you will be like them. Indeed, Allah will gather the hypocrites and the disbelievers all together in Hell.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on sitting with those who mock Allah's verses according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to establish the principle of *al-Judhūr* (rooting out hypocrisy) and the necessity of distinguishing between sincere believers and those who mock divine truth, even if they claim faith. The command to not remain seated until they change the subject highlights that passive complicity in mockery renders one spiritually akin to the mockers, a concept reinforced by the gathering of *Munafiqeen* and *Kuffar* in Hell, emphasizing that hypocrisy is a distinct category from mere disbelief.
